easyPrerequisites: Lumbering Battlement must be exiled by Phantom Steed, and Lagrella must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Lagrella for its mana cost.
When Lagrella enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lagrella's ETB.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Lumbering Battlement is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lumbering Battlement enters, it exiles Lagrella until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lumbering Battlement's ETB.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Lumbering Battlement until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
When Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, Lagrella is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
